mapper.select: SELECT id, plant_id, task_type, due_date, done, created_at FROM care_plan_item WHERE plant_id=#{plantId} AND done=#{done} ORDER BY due_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO care_plan_item(plant_id, task_type, due_date, done) VALUES(#{plantId}, #{taskType}, #{dueDate}, #{done})
mapper.update: UPDATE care_plan_item SET plant_id=#{plantId}, task_type=#{taskType}, due_date=#{dueDate}, done=#{done} WHERE id=#{id}
